title: The 9 Best Air Fryer Toaster Ovens
h1: The 9 Best Air Fryer Toaster Ovens
metaDescription: Our 9 picks for air fryer toaster ovens, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at air fryer toaster ovens using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Ninja DT201 Foodi 10-in-1 XL Pro Air Fry Digital Countertop Convection Toaster Oven
products.blurb: Key specs: 1800W with twin heating elements and a high-speed fan, 10-in-1 functions including air fry, air roast, dehydrate, and toast, 2-rack simultaneous cooking, a full sheet pan on each level.
strengths: Fastest, crispiest air fry results in this roundup thanks to the higher fan speed and twin elements
2-rack capacity means a full sheet of fries and a tray of wings can cook at the same time without swapping racks
10 functions cover nearly every countertop cooking task, reducing the need for a separate air fryer or toaster
Digital presets remove the guesswork of matching time and temperature for common foods
limitations: Largest footprint in the category, needs more counter depth than single-rack models
Fan noise is noticeably louder than the Cuisinart or Breville during air fry cycles
Two racks means two trays and two crumb areas to clean after a full-capacity cook
features: 1800W with twin heating elements and a high-speed fan
10-in-1 functions including air fry, air roast, dehydrate, and toast
2-rack simultaneous cooking, a full sheet pan on each level
Fits a 13-inch pizza or a whole chicken
Digital display with presets, no manual guesswork on time or temp

products.name: Cuisinart TOA-60 Air Fryer Toaster Oven
products.blurb: Key specs: 1800W with dedicated air fry setting and mesh Air Fryer Rack, 7 functions: air fry, convection bake, convection broil, bake, broil, warm, toast, 0.6 cubic foot cavity fits a 12-inch pizza.
strengths: Genuinely crispy air fry results on fries and wings, roughly 85-90% as crisp as a dedicated basket air fryer
0.6 cubic foot interior fits a 12-inch pizza while staying compact enough for smaller counters
Analog dials are simple and reliable, with no software or app dependency
Price sits well below the Ninja and Breville while still delivering a real air fry function
limitations: Thermostat runs 15°F to 25°F off the set temperature, so baking needs manual compensation
No digital timer display, just a mechanical dial that counts down
Single rack only, so air frying and baking a second dish simultaneously isn't possible
features: 1800W with dedicated air fry setting and mesh Air Fryer Rack
7 functions: air fry, convection bake, convection broil, bake, broil, warm, toast
0.6 cubic foot cavity fits a 12-inch pizza
Analog dial controls with a mechanical timer
Includes Baking Pan and Broil Rack accessories

products.name: COSORI Air Fryer Toaster Oven Combo 14-in-1
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W with 14-in-1 preset functions including air fry, dehydrate, and proof, 12-quart / 0.5 cubic foot cavity fits a 9-inch pizza or 4.5 lb chicken, Includes a non-stick air fry basket and drip pan.
strengths: 14 presets cover more specialty functions (dehydrate, proof, ferment) than most competitors at this price
Digital touchscreen is easier to use precisely than analog dial competitors
Compact footprint fits smaller kitchens without sacrificing a real air fry basket
limitations: Smaller 0.5 cubic foot cavity struggles with a 12-inch pizza or a full-size sheet pan
Interior light is dim, making it hard to check food without opening the door
Build materials feel noticeably lighter-duty than the Ninja or Breville over years of daily use
features: 1500W with 14-in-1 preset functions including air fry, dehydrate, and proof
12-quart / 0.5 cubic foot cavity fits a 9-inch pizza or 4.5 lb chicken
Includes a non-stick air fry basket and drip pan
Digital touchscreen with 12 one-touch presets
Shade dial for toast darkness control

products.name: Instant Pot Omni Plus 11-in-1 Toaster Oven Air Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1800W with 11-in-1 functions including air fry, dehydrate, and rotisserie, 0.6 cubic foot cavity with rotisserie spit and forks included, 7-inch full-color digital display.
strengths: Rotisserie function is a genuine differentiator, no other model in this roundup includes a spit and forks
Large color display makes function and time selection more intuitive than dial-based competitors
11 functions and the included rotisserie kit reduce the need for a separate rotisserie appliance
Reheat mode is calibrated to avoid overcooking leftovers, a common issue on basic reheat settings
limitations: Air fry crisping is noticeably less aggressive than the Ninja or Breville due to a lower fan speed
Rotisserie kit adds bulk and requires extra storage space when not in use
Digital display and multiple functions mean a steeper learning curve than simpler dial models
features: 1800W with 11-in-1 functions including air fry, dehydrate, and rotisserie
0.6 cubic foot cavity with rotisserie spit and forks included
7-inch full-color digital display
Includes air fry basket, rotisserie kit, and 2 wire racks

products.name: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro BOV900BSS
products.blurb: Key specs: 1800W with Element IQ independently controlled elements, 13 cooking functions including air fry, dehydrate, proof, and slow cook, 1 cubic foot cavity fits a 13-inch pizza or a 14-lb turkey.
strengths: Element IQ produces more even air fry browning than fixed-element competitors, confirmed across full-rack tests
1 cubic foot interior is the largest in this roundup, fits a 14-lb turkey or two racks of food
13 functions including slow cook and proof replace several separate appliances
Build quality and thermostat accuracy match Breville's non-air-fry Smart Oven line
limitations: Large 1 cubic foot footprint requires significant dedicated counter space
Overkill for households that only want basic air fry without the extra functions

products.name: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven
products.blurb: Key specs: 1800W with French door opening instead of a drop-down door, 26-quart / 0.9 cubic foot cavity fits a 12-lb turkey or 12-inch pizza, 8 functions including air fry, rotisserie, dehydrate, and roast.
strengths: French doors are a genuine usability upgrade, no reaching over a hot drop-down door to pull a rack
26-quart capacity rivals the Ninja for large-batch cooking, fitting a 12-lb turkey
Rotisserie kit included at a lower price than the Instant Pot Omni Plus
Large capacity makes it a realistic secondary oven for holiday cooking
limitations: French door hinges require more clearance in front of the unit than swing-down doors
Air fry crisping is less consistent on the outer edges of the large cavity
Bulkiest unit in this roundup outside the Ninja, needing a dedicated counter zone
